source_instruction: i'm looking for a jet-4 bluetooth portable speaker
query: Ugh, I’ve been stressing so much this week because my neighbor’s golden retriever keeps digging up the heirloom marigolds I planted along my fence line, I tried putting down that prickly mesh stuff last weekend and it didn’t work at all, plus I burned my oatmeal so bad this morning the smoke alarm went off and my roommate thought we were having an actual house fire. Oh, anyway, I’m looking for a boombox or portable radio right now, it needs to have stereo sound, I want the grey color option, it has to be under $120, and it absolutely has to come with a detachable shoulder strap included.

extras.text: it absolutely has to come with a detachable shoulder strap included
